notes: The update sheet (patch notes + Install now / Install later) now pops up on silent auto-checks even while music is playing — before this,a silent check during playback was quietly remembered only as a flag, so you could miss it entirely. Applying is still playback-safe: if you tap Install now while a song plays, the reload waits until you leave the app — your music is never cut.
Picking "Install later" on the sheet still silences further auto-check popups for that version — you won't be asked twice about the same update.
